Examples include storage, photo editing, bookkeeping, themes, travel albums and backup; none are observed product data or recommended quotas. Source mappings identify relevant premises, not proof of causal effects or universally optimal boundaries. No product metrics, pricing recommendations, budgets, runtime or market experiments are included.
